descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione AMEOS Switzerland — part of the AMEOS Group (hospitals, polyclinics, rehabilitation and care facilities). Swiss locations: AMEOS Seeklinikum Brunnen (SZ), AMEOS Spital Einsiedeln (SZ), AMEOS Holding Zurich. Position: Stv. Stationsleitung (m/f/d) Interdisciplinary bed station (Einsiedeln, SZ). --- Mansioni - Shape the future in Einsiedeln with us! Support of the station management in the personnel and professional management of the care team - Share responsibility for ensuring professional, evidence-based care - Assumption of daily responsibility in the absence of the station management Active participation in direct patient care Coordination of interdisciplinary cooperation with the medical service and other professional groups - Participation in service planning and in personnel development and promotion Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards - Participation in projects and in the further development of care processes ---
• Requirements - Completed training as a dipl. Nurse HF/FH or equivalent recognition (mandatory SRK recognition for foreign diploma) - Several years of professional experience in the acute field, ideally on an interdisciplinary bed station - Initial management experience or completed/commenced training in management is advantageous High social and professional competence as well as strong team skills - Organizational strength, resilience and solution-oriented working methods - Joy of interdisciplinary cooperation and the further development of care quality Good IT user knowledge and willingness to co-create digital processes --- Cosa of Friamo - A responsible and varied leadership function Engaged, interprofessional team and appreciative collaboration Structured familiarization and support in the leadership role - Attractive training and further education opportunities - Contemporary employment conditions and good social benefits - Possibility for active participation in processes and structures --- Contatto Use it for more information Please contact the station management, Ms. Kerstin Wyen, at: - Tel. +41 (0)55 418 55 51 - Email: kerstin.wyen@einsiedeln.ameos.ch We are happy to expect your complete application with letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, certificates via our online applicant portal.
